mentions.name: Whisperit v3
mentions.description: Voice-first document automation platform for lawyers. It provides a case-context AI assistant with file attachments, skill system, and next-action suggestions; a visual workflow engine for legal document pipelines (intake to draft, review, send); a modular prompt skills system; bidirectional Google Drive and OneDrive sync; Outlook, Gmail, and IMAP email integration; template multi-output generation; BYO AI provider settings at user/workspace/admin levels; and canvas boards with AI context for visual case planning. Built with Next.js 16, FastAPI + LangGraph, and Supabase.
mentions.problem: Lawyers spend 60%+ of their time writing documents.
mentions.audience: Lawyers and legal professionals drowning in document work.
